_comment: Tier 2 validation rules (R2 7.2): checks the registry's structure cannot imply. Hand-authored. build.py merges these into logical_schemas.json, which is generated and must not be edited directly. Each rule's query returns offending rows; an empty result is a pass (R2 7.3).

core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, COUNT(*) AS n_axes, MAX(axis_index) AS max_axis FROM core_array_dimensions GROUP BY array_asset_id HAVING MAX(axis_index) <> COUNT(*) - 1 OR MIN(axis_index) <> 0

core.array_dimensions.message: an axis declares more than one coordinate form
core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, axis_index FROM core_array_dimensions WHERE (CASE WHEN origin_tick IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN origin_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN coordinate_array_asset_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN coordinate_resource IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1

core.array_dimensions.message: a regular tick axis needs clock_id, origin_tick and step_ticks
core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, axis_index FROM core_array_dimensions WHERE origin_tick IS NOT NULL AND (step_ticks IS NULL OR clock_id IS NULL)

core.array_dimensions.message: a regular numeric axis needs origin_value, step_value and coordinate_unit
core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, axis_index FROM core_array_dimensions WHERE origin_value IS NOT NULL AND (step_value IS NULL OR coordinate_unit IS NULL)

core.array_dimensions.message: coordinate_resource and coordinate_position_column must be present together
core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, axis_index FROM core_array_dimensions WHERE (coordinate_resource IS NULL) <> (coordinate_position_column IS NULL)

core.array_dimensions.message: a core axis points outward at a non-core resource (R20 §5.1)
core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, axis_index, coordinate_resource FROM core_array_dimensions WHERE coordinate_resource IS NOT NULL AND coordinate_resource NOT LIKE 'core.%'

core.clocks.message: neither tick_rate_hz nor an exact rational rate is present
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE tick_rate_hz IS NULL AND (tick_rate_num IS NULL OR tick_rate_den IS NULL)
SELECT clock_id, tick_rate_hz, tick_rate_num, tick_rate_den FROM core_clocks WHERE tick_rate_hz <= 0 OR tick_rate_num <= 0 OR tick_rate_den <= 0

core.clocks.message: transform_slope and transform_offset must be present together
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE (transform_slope IS NULL) <> (transform_offset IS NULL)

core.clocks.message: a clock transform is declared without a parent clock
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE parent_clock_id IS NULL AND transform_slope IS NOT NULL

core.clocks.message: tick_zero_utc is more than a day from session_start_time
core.clocks.sql: SELECT c.clock_id, c.tick_zero_utc, s.session_start_time FROM core_clocks c JOIN core_sessions s USING (session_id) WHERE c.tick_zero_utc IS NOT NULL AND s.session_start_time IS NOT NULL AND (c.tick_zero_utc < s.session_start_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY OR c.tick_zero_utc > s.session_start_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

core.clocks.message: a clock declares both a linear transform and anchor points
core.clocks.sql: SELECT c.clock_id FROM core_clocks c WHERE c.transform_slope IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_clock_anchors a WHERE a.clock_id = c.clock_id)

core.processing_runs.message: a failed run is recorded in a committed packet
core.processing_runs.sql: SELECT processing_run_id, activity_type FROM core_processing_runs WHERE status = 'failed'

core.sessions.message: the manifest sessions list disagrees with core.sessions
core.sessions.sql: SELECT session_id FROM core_sessions WHERE session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM manifest_sessions) UNION ALL SELECT session_id FROM manifest_sessions WHERE session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM core_sessions)

core.sorting_runs.message: spikes carry amplitudes but the sorting run declares no amplitude_unit
core.sorting_runs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sorting_run_id FROM core_spike_events s JOIN core_sorting_runs r USING (sorting_run_id) WHERE s.amplitude IS NOT NULL AND r.amplitude_unit IS NULL

core.spike_events.message: negative ticks on a clock with no absolute reference
core.spike_events.sql: SELECT s.session_id, s.clock_id, MIN(s.t_tick) AS min_tick FROM core_spike_events s JOIN core_clocks c USING (clock_id) WHERE s.t_tick < 0 AND c.tick_zero_utc IS NULL GROUP BY s.session_id, s.clock_id

core.units.message: n_spikes, first_spike_tick or last_spike_tick disagrees with core.spike_events
core.units.sql: SELECT u.session_id, u.unit_id FROM core_units u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(t_tick) AS lo, MAX(t_tick) AS hi FROM core_spike_events GROUP BY session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id ) s USING (session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id) WHERE (u.n_spikes IS NOT NULL AND u.n_spikes IS DISTINCT FROM s.n) OR (u.first_spike_tick IS NOT NULL AND u.first_spike_tick IS DISTINCT FROM s.lo) OR (u.last_spike_tick IS NOT NULL AND u.last_spike_tick IS DISTINCT FROM s.hi)

core.units.message: the designated quality label is not among the recorded ones
core.units.sql: SELECT u.session_id, u.unit_id, u.quality_label, u.quality_label_source FROM core_units u LEFT JOIN core_unit_quality_labels q ON u.session_id = q.session_id AND u.unit_id = q.unit_id AND u.sorting_run_id = q.sorting_run_id AND u.curation_id = q.curation_id AND u.quality_label = q.normalized_label AND u.quality_label_source = q.source WHERE u.quality_label IS NOT NULL AND q.source IS NULL

core.units.message: quality_label and quality_label_source must be present together
core.units.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id FROM core_units WHERE (quality_label IS NULL) <> (quality_label_source IS NULL)

core.clock_anchors.message: anchors are declared for a clock with no parent
core.clock_anchors.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.clock_id FROM core_clock_anchors a JOIN core_clocks c USING (clock_id) WHERE c.parent_clock_id IS NULL
SELECT clock_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(anchor_index) AS hi FROM core_clock_anchors GROUP BY clock_id HAVING MAX(anchor_index) <> COUNT(*) - 1 OR MIN(anchor_index) <> 0

core.clock_anchors.message: anchor sequences do not increase together, so interpolation is undefined
core.clock_anchors.sql: SELECT clock_id, anchor_index FROM ( SELECT *, LAG(t_tick) OVER (PARTITION BY clock_id ORDER BY anchor_index) AS prev_t, LAG(parent_tick) OVER (PARTITION BY clock_id ORDER BY anchor_index) AS prev_p FROM core_clock_anchors) WHERE prev_t IS NOT NULL AND (t_tick <= prev_t OR parent_tick <= prev_p)

core.unit_observation_intervals.overlap_message: observation windows overlap, which would double-count observed time

core.array_assets.message: scaling is declared both on the array and per channel
core.array_assets.sql: SELECT a.array_asset_id FROM core_array_assets a WHERE a.conversion IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_array_channels c WHERE c.array_asset_id = a.array_asset_id AND c.conversion IS NOT NULL)

core.array_assets.message: sample_rate_hz disagrees with the time axis step
core.array_assets.sql: SELECT a.array_asset_id, a.sample_rate_hz FROM core_array_assets a JOIN core_array_dimensions d USING (array_asset_id) JOIN core_clocks c ON c.clock_id = d.clock_id WHERE a.sample_rate_hz IS NOT NULL AND d.step_ticks IS NOT NULL AND c.tick_rate_hz IS NOT NULL AND abs(a.sample_rate_hz - c.tick_rate_hz / d.step_ticks) > 1e-6

core.array_channels.message: a conversion without a unit yields a number in no known quantity
core.array_channels.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, channel_index FROM core_array_channels WHERE conversion IS NOT NULL AND unit IS NULL

core.unit_quality_labels.message: a (source, label) pair projects onto more than one normalized_label
core.unit_quality_labels.sql: SELECT source, label, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(normalized_label, '')) AS distinct_projections FROM core_unit_quality_labels GROUP BY source, label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(normalized_label, '')) > 1

core.events.message: an event's clock_id disagrees with its stream's
core.events.sql: SELECT e.session_id, e.event_id, e.clock_id, s.clock_id AS stream_clock_id FROM core_events e JOIN core_event_streams s ON e.stream_id = s.event_stream_id WHERE e.clock_id <> s.clock_id
